name: s3-archiver
changelog: v1: archive interface provider backed by S3 (SigV4, path-style)
title: S3 Archiver
description: Stores component backups in an S3 bucket. Bind a component's @archive to it (or make it the workspace default) and backups, scheduled backups, and offload all stream here. Works with AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2 — any S3-compatible endpoint. Credentials live in the tile's vault.
